segments.mil7.8.3:1.1: “Bhante nāgasena,‘chattassa tīṇi aṅgāni gahetabbānī’ti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni tīṇi aṅgāni gahetabbānī”ti?
segments.mil7.8.3:1.2: “Yathā, mahārāja, chattaṃ upari muddhani carati, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena kilesānaṃ upari muddhani carena bhavitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.8.3:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, chattassa paṭhamaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.8.3:2.1: “Puna caparaṃ, mahārāja, chattaṃ muddhanupatthambhaṃ hoti, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena yoniso manasikārupatthambhena bhavitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.8.3:2.3: Idaṃ, mahārāja, chattassa dutiyaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.8.3:3.1: “Puna caparaṃ, mahārāja, chattaṃ vātātapameghavuṭṭhiyo paṭihanati, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena nānāvidhadiṭṭhiputhusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ [mahāvāta (ka.)] matavātatividhaggisantāpakilesavuṭṭhiyo paṭihantabbā.
segments.mil7.8.3:3.3: Idaṃ, mahārāja, chattassa tatiyaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
